title: Body mass
text: Weigh under the same conditions each time: same time of day, similar clothing, after using the toilet. In microgravity use the body-mass measurement device, not a scale.
There is no published single-reading limit; the trend against the personal baseline is what matters. Rapid unexplained loss goes to the crew medical officer.

citations.source: App design: baseline scoring only; no published single-reading limit.
